connector.name: CrewOne
connector.registryDescription: Taiwan film equipment rates, studios, photographer/director references; AI pre-production tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tzipway-dotcom account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CREWONE_API_KEY
env.description: CrewOne API key for paid tools (create_project, get_project, export_pdf). Get one at https://crewone.ai/dashboard/settings/api. Free tools (search_equipment, search_studios, get_photographer, list_photographers, get_director, list_directors) work without a key.
